evidenceClaims.claim: Flow-cytometry interpretation depends on appropriate instrument setup, compensation/unmixing, controls, gating logic and reporting; attractive plots do not substitute for these QC steps.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Fluorescence-minus-one and other appropriate controls can help define gates in multicolor flow cytometry; isotype controls answer different questions and are not universal substitutes for FMO controls.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: MIFlowCyt defines minimum experimental/reporting information for flow cytometry so data generation and analysis can be evaluated and reproduced.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Annexin V reports phosphatidylserine exposure and is commonly combined with a membrane-impermeant viability dye to distinguish viable/early-apoptotic/late-apoptotic-or-necrotic populations; interpretation is time- and context-dependent.
evidenceClaims.qualification: Annexin positivity is not a complete mechanistic proof of apoptosis by itself.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Metabolic/ATP-based viability assays provide proxy readouts related to viable cell number but can be altered by treatment-induced metabolism and must be operated within an assay-specific linear range.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: A higher colorimetric/luminescent viability signal should not be interpreted automatically as a proportional increase in cell number unless the assay has been validated for linearity in that cell system.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Quantitative immunoassays require an appropriate standard curve, working range and sample dilution; values outside the validated range should not be extrapolated as if equally reliable.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Matrix effects, heterophile antibodies and high-dose hook/prozone effects can distort immunoassay results; dilution/parallelism and controls can be diagnostic.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Scratch/wound-closure assays conflate cell migration with proliferation unless proliferation is controlled or independently measured.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Migration and invasion assays measure different biological properties and are highly sensitive to assay geometry, matrix, gradients, cell density and quantification choices; assay choice should match the biological question.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Transwell invasion through matrix is not interchangeable with simple migration through an uncoated membrane; matrix composition and pore/gradient conditions affect interpretation.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: Drug-combination synergy depends on the chosen null model; Bliss, Loewe and ZIP encode different reference assumptions and can produce different synergy scores on the same matrix.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: SynergyFinder implements multiple reference models for dose-response matrices; a synergy score should be interpreted together with the full dose-response surface and experimental uncertainty.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

evidenceClaims.claim: ZIP defines zero interaction potency as a specific reference model; it should not be presented as a universal biological definition of drug synergy.
evidenceClaims.reviewerNote: Externally pre-reviewed; final ResearchOS claim_verified promotion reserved for Codex/formal source-pack gate.

problemCards.title_cn: FSC/SSC圈出来的一团就能直接叫某类细胞吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can an FSC/SSC cloud define a cell type?
problemCards.observation: 仅根据scatter区域命名具体immune cell type。
problemCards.why_it_matters: scatter反映size/granularity等物理特征但通常缺乏足够lineage specificity。

problemCards.title_cn: 多色流式不用 compensation/unmixing，只看颜色分得开可以吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can multicolor flow skip compensation/unmixing?
problemCards.observation: fluorophore spectra重叠但未做corrective workflow。
problemCards.why_it_matters: spectral spillover可制造假阳性/改变群体边界。

problemCards.title_cn: isotype control 能代替 FMO control 吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can an isotype control replace an FMO control?
problemCards.observation: 复杂multicolor panel用isotype确定所有gate。
problemCards.why_it_matters: FMO与isotype回答不同控制问题；FMO更直接反映其余fluorophores造成的spread对gate的影响。

problemCards.title_cn: gating 顺序改一下结果差很多，说明什么？
problemCards.title_en: Why does gating order change the result?
problemCards.observation: 不同analyst/gating sequence得到显著不同population frequency。
problemCards.why_it_matters: gating是分析模型的一部分，需要预设/可复现/控制双ts、dead cells和artifacts。

problemCards.title_cn: Annexin V 阳性就等于“已经证实 apoptosis”吗？
problemCards.title_en: Does Annexin V positivity prove apoptosis?
problemCards.observation: 单独Annexin V+被写成mechanistic apoptosis proof。
problemCards.why_it_matters: PS exposure是常用apoptotic marker，但时间、membrane integrity和其他过程会影响解释。
problemCards.claim_boundary: 可支持apoptosis-compatible phenotype；强机制结论需要补充证据。

problemCards.title_cn: Annexin V+/PI+ 一定是“晚期凋亡”，完全不能是坏死吗？
problemCards.title_en: Is Annexin V+/PI+ uniquely late apoptosis?
problemCards.observation: 双阳性population被唯一命名为late apoptosis。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 双阳性表示PS exposure与膜完整性丧失的组合，终末apoptosis/secondary necrosis和其他membrane-compromised states需结合上下文。
problemCards.claim_boundary: 不要把单一二维gate当唯一细胞死亡机制鉴定。

problemCards.title_cn: CCK-8/MTT 吸光值翻倍，就等于细胞数翻倍吗？
problemCards.title_en: Does a doubled metabolic assay signal mean doubled cell number?
problemCards.observation: 药物/处理改变metabolism，直接把OD按cell number解释。
problemCards.why_it_matters: metabolic proxy受每细胞代谢状态和assay linearity影响。

problemCards.title_cn: CCK-8 做到细胞铺满还继续读OD，结果可靠吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can viability assays be quantified after confluence/saturation?
problemCards.observation: 高密度或长孵育使signal进入plateau。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 超出线性区后signal不再按viable-cell amount比例变化。

problemCards.title_cn: 药物让细胞代谢下降但没有死亡，CCK-8 会怎么表现？
problemCards.title_en: Can metabolic inhibition mimic cytotoxicity?
problemCards.observation: 处理降低ATP/还原代谢，viability proxy下降。
problemCards.why_it_matters: proxy signal下降可能反映metabolic suppression而非细胞数/死亡的同等下降。
problemCards.claim_boundary: 单一metabolic assay不宜独立承担cell death mechanism结论。

problemCards.title_cn: 样本OD超过标准曲线最高点，直接外推浓度可以吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can ELISA values above the standard curve be extrapolated?
problemCards.observation: sample signal高于validated calibration range。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 曲线外extrapolation的不确定性和非线性风险显著增大。

problemCards.title_cn: 浓度越高反而信号越低，可能是什么？
problemCards.title_en: Why can very high analyte concentrations reduce immunoassay signal?
problemCards.observation: 极高浓度sample出现异常低signal。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 某些sandwich immunoassays可出现high-dose hook/prozone effect。

problemCards.title_cn: 同一浓度标准品在buffer里正常，在血清里偏低，为什么？
problemCards.title_en: Why does matrix change immunoassay recovery?
problemCards.observation: spike在buffer与serum中表现不同。
problemCards.why_it_matters: matrix components可影响binding/signal，造成recovery/parallelism问题。

problemCards.title_cn: scratch closure 变快，就证明迁移增强吗？
problemCards.title_en: Does faster scratch closure prove increased migration?
problemCards.observation: 24h wound closure更快但细胞增殖也增强。
problemCards.why_it_matters: closure由migration和proliferation共同贡献。

problemCards.title_cn: 划痕宽度不一致还可以直接比较closure百分比吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can unequal initial scratch widths be compared naively?
problemCards.observation: 不同well初始wound geometry明显不同。
problemCards.why_it_matters: initial geometry和imaging/segmentation影响closure quantification。
recommended_reasoning: 标准化初始伤口并用baseline-normalized quantification。

problemCards.title_cn: Matrigel Transwell 细胞更多就等于“侵袭机制增强”吗？
problemCards.title_en: Does more Matrigel transwell passage prove invasion mechanism?
problemCards.observation: 穿膜细胞数增加被直接写成specific invasion pathway activation。
problemCards.why_it_matters: assay读出受migration、viability、chemotaxis、matrix properties和cell number影响。
problemCards.claim_boundary: 支持assay-defined invasive behavior，不单独证明具体机制。

problemCards.title_cn: Transwell 上层/下层培养基差别不清，结果还能解释chemotaxis吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can transwell migration be called chemotaxis without a defined gradient?
problemCards.observation: 上下室条件没有明确gradient或serum差异。
problemCards.why_it_matters: migration、chemokinesis与chemotaxis是不同现象，gradient design决定可解释性。

problemCards.title_cn: Bliss=10、Loewe=-2，哪个才是真 synergy？
problemCards.title_en: What if Bliss and Loewe disagree?
problemCards.observation: 同一dose matrix不同null models给相反synergy判断。
problemCards.why_it_matters: 不同synergy模型定义不同“无相互作用”参考。
problemCards.claim_boundary: synergy不是单一模型无关的物理常数。

problemCards.title_cn: 只测一个剂量组合得到效果特别好，可以叫 synergy 吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can one dose pair establish synergy?
problemCards.observation: 只比较一个A+B点和单药。
problemCards.why_it_matters: synergy inference需要相对于剂量反应的reference model；单点缺乏完整dose-response context。

problemCards.title_cn: ZIP score高就说明临床联合一定更好？
problemCards.title_en: Does a high ZIP score imply clinical combination benefit?
problemCards.observation: in vitro matrix synergy直接外推患者获益。
problemCards.why_it_matters: in vitro interaction score不包含PK、toxicity、tumor heterogeneity或therapeutic window。
problemCards.claim_boundary: supports in-vitro interaction under assay conditions, not clinical efficacy.

problemCards.title_cn: 组合更杀细胞，但单药本身已接近100%杀伤，synergy score还可靠吗？
problemCards.title_en: What happens near assay saturation in drug synergy?
problemCards.observation: 高剂量单药/组合接近floor/ceiling。
problemCards.why_it_matters: dose-response dynamic range和measurement floor/ceiling会限制interaction估计。
recommended_reasoning: 重点看完整response surface和可辨识浓度区。

problemCards.title_cn: 死细胞不排除会影响marker阳性率吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can dead cells distort flow marker positivity?
problemCards.observation: 没有live/dead gate，dead cells非特异signal高。
problemCards.why_it_matters: dead/damaged cells可改变autofluorescence和nonspecific binding，影响population estimates。

problemCards.title_cn: doublets 不排除会制造“双阳性”亚群吗？
problemCards.title_en: Can doublets create apparent double-positive populations?
problemCards.observation: two-cell aggregates被当single events。
problemCards.why_it_matters: doublets可把两个不同lineage信号合并成假double-positive event。
